title: Torsion-stabilized modular curves of level $p$
summary: This is the first paper of a project on new integral models $\mathcal{X}(N)$ of the modular curve $X(N)$. The final results for a general level $N$ will be obtained in the second paper, while this paper is devoted to giving all necessary background and definitions applicable to any $N$ and then working out the case of $\mathcal{X}(p)$ with all possible details. We define $\mathcal{X}(N)$ as the closure of $Y(N)$ in the space $\overline{\mathcal{M}}_{1,N^2}=\overline{\mathcal{M}}_{1,Γ}$, where $Γ=(\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z})^2$, and show that for $N=p$ it is the blowup of the Katz-Mazur model…
